cases.input: One Person is concurrently employed by two legal employers.
cases.expect: Two Employment records and two employer-scoped EmployeeProfiles reference one Person; employee numbers never merge across employers.

cases.input: One Person has two concurrent governed contracts with one employer.
cases.expect: One EmployeeProfile references two distinct Employment records and any concurrent Assignments resolve to one explicit context each.

cases.input: A staffing supplier legally employs a worker placed at a work customer.
cases.expect: Employer, supplier, host and work customer roles remain explicit; the host Assignment resolves to the supplier Employment.

cases.input: A profile category says freelancer although control and integration evidence conflict.
cases.expect: The label cannot establish status; sourced assertions, competent determination and dispute history remain visible.

cases.input: A separated worker returns to the same employer.
cases.expect: The same Person and EmployeeProfile are reused, a new Employment and Assignment are created, and number reuse follows scheme policy.

cases.input: A Person changes legal employer without evidenced succession.
cases.expect: A new employer-scoped EmployeeProfile and Employment are created while Person identity is unchanged.

cases.input: A legal succession decision preserves employment continuity.
cases.expect: The Employment relationship may continue with explicit succession evidence; the event is not silently treated as rehire.

cases.input: The worker moves to a materially different host.
cases.expect: A new Assignment is created; Person, EmployeeProfile and Employment are preserved.

cases.input: FTE and reporting line change without material post, host, scope or authority change.
cases.expect: An effective-dated amendment preserves Employment and Assignment identity.

cases.input: A previously recorded title is corrected without a real-world event.
cases.expect: Record versioning corrects provenance without inventing a lifecycle transition.

cases.input: Employment and JML case are closed but two access outcomes remain unverified.
cases.expect: Employment may be inactive while access obligations remain open; revocation and completion are not inferred.

cases.input: A consumer treats EmployeeProfile existence as employee status.
cases.expect: The assertion is rejected because status belongs to sourced, qualified Employment determinations.

cases.input: Two employers issue the same employee number and a consumer merges the people.
cases.expect: The merge is rejected because number scope includes employer, scheme and validity.

cases.input: One scheme reissues a number while an earlier binding is still valid.
cases.expect: Validation fails unless the scheme and non-overlapping validity permit reuse.

cases.input: Rehire processing attempts to overwrite the former Employment and number binding.
cases.expect: The write is rejected; predecessor history remains resolvable.

cases.input: A Work Assignment lacks an Employment or engagement context.
cases.expect: The Assignment is invalid for this profile.

cases.input: A closed offboarding case is used as proof of access revocation.
cases.expect: The claim fails without independently verified access-authority evidence.

cases.input: A generator assigns an EmployeeProfile model ID without registry allocation.
cases.expect: Generation fails closed and the candidate remains identifier-unassigned.

cases.input: A second open profile is requested for the same Person and employer.
cases.expect: A conforming validator must reject it and preserve the existing profile, links and number history.

cases.input: employerRef resolves to a unit or payroll code.
cases.expect: A conforming validator must reject the profile before number-scope evaluation.

cases.input: A staffing supplier is stored as free text without an owning master.
cases.expect: The non-collapse claim must remain held and the free-text value must not count as evidence.

cases.input: A Person merge attempts to rewrite personRef in place.
cases.expect: A conforming implementation must preserve both histories and require evidenced profile succession.

cases.input: A consumer cites EmployeeProfile's name as proof of employee status.
cases.expect: The claim must be rejected; only a qualified determination can answer status.

cases.input: A contractor relationship is typed as employment only to satisfy a reference.
cases.expect: The write must be rejected; relationshipKind must preserve the governed WM-ORG-005 type.

cases.input: A recorded fact is corrected without real-world change.
cases.expect: A new correction version must retain valid time, advance record time and keep the prior version readable.

cases.input: Withdrawal requests deletion of the prior version.
cases.expect: Deletion must be rejected; the version and reason remain resolvable.

cases.input: Two active versions overlap in valid time in one record-time slice.
cases.expect: A conforming validator must reject the overlap.

cases.input: A number was issued in error.
cases.expect: A voided binding must remain readable, not occupy uniqueness, and not imply prior possession.

cases.input: A historical query addresses a number from a closed profile.
cases.expect: The binding must resolve for instants inside its validity interval.

cases.input: A proposed profile has no relationship link.
cases.expect: The profile is valid and yields no Employment rather than an employee-status assertion.

cases.input: One relationship is linked to two profiles at overlapping valid time without succession evidence.
cases.expect: A conforming validator must reject the second link.

cases.input: Evidenced employer succession preserves one Employment.
cases.expect: The predecessor profile is superseded, a successor profile opens, the link transfers by dated evidence and histories remain readable.

cases.input: successorRef targets a different Person.
cases.expect: A conforming validator must reject the succession.

cases.input: A former worker is rehired by the same employer.
cases.expect: The closed profile may reactivate with a new link while prior relationship and number history remain unchanged.

cases.input: This package claims it validates Assignment context locally.
cases.expect: The claim must be rejected and referred to WM-ORG-016 with inherited holds.

cases.input: A statutory category assertion lacks determinationRef.
cases.expect: It must be rejected; an internal-reporting assertion may remain explicitly non-determinative.

cases.input: One profile links concurrent employee and contractor relationships.
cases.expect: Each category assertion must reference exactly one relationship and queries must not bleed across them.

cases.input: An FTE amendment creates a new profile version.
cases.expect: The independent category assertion must remain unchanged and singly sourced.

cases.input: A classification determination is overturned.
cases.expect: The original and overturning records must remain readable with resolved-overturned state.

cases.input: A number scheme declares no reuse policy.
cases.expect: Issuance must fail closed.

cases.input: A binding scope differs from its profile employer.
cases.expect: It must be rejected before uniqueness evaluation.

cases.input: Profile closure is requested with unverified access outcomes.
cases.expect: Closure must fail; dormant is permitted and obligations remain open.

cases.input: A consumer reads dormant profile as proof of terminated Employment.
cases.expect: The inference must be rejected; Employment is authoritative.

cases.input: A generator emits registry holds as instance validation.
cases.expect: The generated instance rules must exclude governance holds.

cases.input: A dependent rule is reported as passed using an unpinned neighbor claim.
cases.expect: The result must be held, not passed.

cases.input: A report calls the declarative cases passing tests.
cases.expect: The report must be rejected while fixturesExecuted is false.
